resources.string: User Notice and Open Source License

Welcome to %s. Please read the user notice below before continuing. This launcher is an unofficial community open source project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Mojang, Microsoft, or NetEase.

This launcher is developed and modified based on Zalith Launcher 1. The original launch kernel and compatibility are preserved, while the interface layer was rewritten and features such as Terracotta multiplayer, automatic Java runtime management and Vulkan rendering support were introduced. The original project author is the Zalith Launcher1 launcher author; the current author of this launcher is 万古沧海.

%s is an unofficial build. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Mojang Studios, Microsoft, or NetEase. Minecraft is a trademark of Mojang Studios. This project exists solely to run Minecraft: Java Edition on Android devices and does not distribute any game content.

The launcher requires network access to fetch version manifests, assets, libraries and runtimes, and sends your account tokens to the relevant official authentication servers or the third party login server you configure. Aside from the information required for authentication, the launcher does not upload your personal files. Account credentials are stored locally on your device.

The launcher stores version files, libraries, resource packs and saves inside the game directory you choose, and keeps settings, account data and multiplayer logs in the app private directory. You can clear the app data from system settings or delete files from the game directory at any time.
